grammar.summary: 本课以「人人靠出售某种东西为生」切入，重点运用了 Though 让步状语从句、There are times when... 定语从句以及 it 作形式主语/宾语的结构。体会作者如何用 Though 让步于「物质可衡量」、用 times when 表达特定时刻、用 it 使长句结构清晰。

points.title: Though 让步状语从句 (Concessive Clause)
points.explanation: though 引导让步状语从句，表示「尽管……」。本课用 Though it may be possible to measure the value of material good 让步于「物质价值可衡量」，随即转折到「服务价值却难以估算」，凸显主题。

examples.en: Though it may be possible to measure the value of material good in terms of money, it is extremely difficult to estimate the true value of the services which people perform for us.
examples.cn: 虽然物质产品的价值可以用金钱来衡量，但要估算别人为我们为所提供的服务的价值却是极其困难的。

points.title: There are times when... 定语从句 (Relative Clause with when)
points.explanation: There are times when... 表示「有时/有些时候……」，when 是关系副词修饰先行词 times，在从句中作时间状语。本课用此结构引出「为救命愿倾尽所有」的特定时刻。

examples.en: There are times when we would willingly give everything we possess to save our lives, yet we might grudge paying a surgeon a high fee for offering us precisely this service.
examples.cn: 有时，我们为了挽救生命，愿意付出我们所占有的一切。但就在外科大夫给我们提供了这种服务后，我们却可能为所支付的昂贵的费用而抱怨。

points.title: it 作形式主语/宾语 (Preparatory it)
points.explanation: it 可作形式主语或形式宾语，代替后面真正的不定式/从句。本课用 it is extremely difficult to estimate...（it 代不定式）、His few material possessions make it possible for him to move...（it 代不定式复合结构），使长句重心后移、结构平衡。

examples.en: it is extremely difficult to estimate the true value of the services which people perform for us.
examples.cn: 要估算别人为我们为所提供的服务的价值却是极其困难的。

examples.en: His few material possessions make it possible for him to move from place to place with ease.
examples.cn: 他几乎没有什么财产，这使他能够轻松自如地在各地奔波。

exercises.q: ______ it may be possible to measure the value of material good in terms of money, it is extremely difficult to estimate the true value of the services.
There are times ______ we would willingly give everything we possess to save our lives.
His few material possessions make ______ possible for him to move from place to place with ease.（用形式宾语）
用动词的适当形式填空：In the light of this statement, teachers live by ______ (sell) knowledge, philosophers by selling wisdom and priests by selling spiritual comfort.
课文中 we might grudge paying a surgeon a high fee 的 grudge 意思是？
